title: Demand Service Rate Programs: One Program to an Account
content:
## The term

An account carries one demand service rate program at a time. A second enrollment is not opened while
the account holds a program in requested, active, pending renewal or suspended standing; a customer who
wants different rates moves the existing program to another tier instead, which takes effect at the next
renewal unless the office agrees to an immediate change. Programs standing expired, cancelled or
declined do not block a new enrollment. The most an account holds at once under the Demand Service Rate Programs is 1 program.

## What the program covers

The program covers every building on the account, so a customer with several buildings does not need one
program per site, and the rates, the block and the emergency allowance are held once at account level
and drawn from wherever the call comes in.

## The same term as a table

| The account's existing program stands | A second enrollment |
|---|---|
| requested | is not opened |
| active | is not opened |
| pending renewal | is not opened |
| suspended | is not opened |
| expired | is not blocked |
| cancelled | is not blocked |
| declined | is not blocked |

The standing that governs is the one the office record carries for the account against which the
enrollment would be opened, read before the enrollment is opened.

### Basis questions

*An owner with a live program asks for the rates of another tier.* The existing program moves to that
other tier, taking effect at the next renewal unless the office agrees to an immediate change.

*An owner with four buildings asks for a program at each.* One program stands at account level and
covers all four, and the rates, the block and the emergency allowance are held once and drawn from
wherever the call comes in.
